📰 General

Mary Beth Hurt, Star of ‘The World According to Garp,’ Dies at 79 •

Mary Beth Hurt, actress known for her roles in films like “Interiors” and “The World According to Garp,” passed away on Sunday at the age of 79. Her death was attributed to complications related to Alzheimer’s disease. Hurt received three Tony Award nominations for her work on Broadway, including a nomination for “The Rose’s Turn.” She had a notable career spanning both film and theatre, leaving behind a legacy of stage and screen performances.

🌍 World

Soaring Oil Prices Boost Russia, But Drone Attacks Threaten Export Capacity •

Russia is experiencing a significant increase in oil revenue due to the disruption of global supply caused by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. Urals crude prices have risen dramatically, approaching parity with Brent crude, a key benchmark. However, Ukrainian drone attacks are severely impacting Russia’s oil export capabilities, particularly targeting refineries and port infrastructure. This dual effect – increased prices and reduced output – presents a complex challenge for the Kremlin’s energy strategy.

🦅 US

Tennessee Faces Michigan in Elite Eight, Model Predicts Wolverines Advance •

The Tennessee Volunteers will compete against the top-seeded Michigan Wolverines in an upcoming Elite Eight matchup within the Midwest Region. Michigan enters the game with a record of 34-3, demonstrating their strong performance throughout the tournament. A predictive model is forecasting the Wolverines’ advancement to the Final Four. The game is scheduled for Sunday and will determine which team progresses further in the NCAA Tournament.

💰 Business

Strait of Hormuz Closure Threatens Massive Oil Price Spike and Consumption Cuts •

A prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz would trigger a substantial decrease in global oil and gas consumption as nations seek alternative supplies. Initial demand reductions have already begun, driven by concerns about supply disruptions. Experts predict a significant price surge, potentially impacting consumer behavior and business operations. The closure would force a shift towards reduced travel and decreased discretionary spending. The situation highlights the vulnerability of the global economy to disruptions in this critical waterway.

💻 Technology

New MacBook Neo Owners Can Instantly Enhance Their Experience with These USB-C Gadgets •

The recently released MacBook Neo is generating significant interest due to its competitive pricing. Several USB-C gadgets are available to expand the MacBook Neo’s functionality and improve its performance. These devices include a USB-C hub offering additional ports, a USB-C to HDMI adapter for connecting to displays, and a USB-C SD card reader for expanded storage options. The accessories aim to address potential limitations of the base model and cater to diverse user needs.

🎭 Entertainment

James Tolkan, ‘Top Gun’ and ‘Back to the Future’ Star, Dies at 94 •

Actor James Tolkan, recognized for his iconic roles in “Top Gun” and “Back to the Future,” passed away on Thursday at the age of 94. He resided in Lake Placid, New York, at the time of his death. Tolkan’s career spanned several decades, primarily featuring him as a stern military figure and a demanding school principal. Booking agent, David Welch, confirmed his passing to Associated Press.

🏅 Sports

UConn Faces Notre Dame in NCAA Tournament Final, Seeking Final Four Berth •

UConn women’s basketball is set to play Notre Dame in the Fort Worth 1 Regional Final on Sunday. The Huskies are pursuing a trip to the Final Four after a largely dominant performance throughout the NCAA Tournament. UConn defeated North Carolina in the Sweet Sixteen, continuing their streak of advancement. The game will determine which team advances to the Women’s Final Four.

🔬 Science

Artemis II Crew Reports Increased Realism as Launch Approaches •

NASA’s Artemis II mission, slated to send four astronauts on the first crewed lunar journey since 1972, is rapidly approaching its launch date. Astronauts involved in the mission have reported a heightened sense of reality as preparations continue. The crew, including Christina Koch, are undergoing final checks and simulations in anticipation of the historic flight. This mission aims to test the Orion spacecraft and its systems before a future crewed landing on the Moon.

🩺 Health

GLP-1 Medications Effective, But Doctors Stress Importance of Lifestyle Alongside •

A recent case involving a caterer, Jelon Smart, highlights the potential benefits of GLP-1 medications for weight loss. Smart began taking the injections after experiencing severe ankle pain and weighing 285 pounds. Doctors are now emphasizing that GLP-1 treatments are most effective when combined with lifestyle modifications, specifically regular movement and attention to mental health. Research suggests that incorporating physical activity and addressing mental well-being can significantly enhance the positive effects of these medications.
